_comment: WSS 9090 transport for the official Fire TV app. STT model/hotwords/initial prompt and command routing come from config/voice_assistant.yaml, the same faster-whisper + CommandHandler the BLE remote uses. mode: command (launch/search/type fallback) | dictation (always type) | log (testing). safe_commands=true only executes short explicit commands with known app targets; everything else is dictated. In the merged install voice-stt.service owns WSS 9090 and shares its model; the receiver detects that automatically.
